newsitem.title: FINLAND: Big year-end deals, Nokia boost Helsinki bourse.
newsitem.headline: Big year-end deals, Nokia boost Helsinki bourse.

text.p: Shares rose on Friday in positive sentiment amid heavy year-end dealings in some smaller firms and window dressing, brokers said.
The market was up more than one percent at the opening on near record gains on Wall Street overnight, but eased slightly. The HEX general index ended 0.75 percent up at 2,451.8 points.
"Funds are competing to see who's best so they are buying their own securities at rising prices," one broker said.
Market bellwether Nokia opened strong but soon came off a high of 265.00 markka -- just under its New York closing price -- to close at 262.50, still up 2.00 markka.

Brokers said the massive over one billion markka volume came on big inhouse deals while real trade in others than Nokia was thin. Sponsor announced big transactions in Suunto, Saunatec and Citycon, but the deals did not change its stakes.

Merita was firm, up 0.10 at 14.20 markka, and Sampo rose 5.00 markka to 340.00 after it got permission for an insurance portfolio transfer which made it possible to concentrate unit-linked products to Henki-Sampo.
Brokers were fairly upbeat about next week, but the market would be quiet due to Christmas, with trade only on Monday and Friday.
